title: TSV 成孔、襯層、阻障與填孔
titleEn: TSV formation, liner, barrier, and fill
description: 深孔的幾何、絕緣連續性與金屬覆蓋共同決定填孔與電性；入口外觀不能代替孔底證據。本模組為 26 個可分支的判讀作業，課程順序不代表量產配方。網站提供原創示意模型；本模組未隨附逐步實測資料或商用允收門檻。
descriptionEn: Via geometry, dielectric continuity, and metal coverage jointly govern fill and electrical behavior; the entrance cannot establish bottom quality. These 26 branching interpretation exercises are a learning sequence, not a production recipe. The site supplies original schematic models, not per-step measured datasets or commercial acceptance limits.
route: TSV 支線；依 via-middle、via-last 與中介層結構選用，並非所有封裝都有 TSV。
routeEn: TSV branch: select for via-middle, via-last, or interposer structures; many packages have no TSVs.

steps.title: TSV 深寬比核對
steps.objective: 判斷「TSV 深寬比核對」是否滿足此具體條件：幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Check TSV aspect ratio meets this specific condition: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：由剖面資料計算孔深與最小孔寬比。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Calculate depth divided by minimum width from cross sections. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 入口寬度代替最窄處會低估填孔難度。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Using entrance width hides the narrowest fill restriction. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.title: TSV 深寬比核對的驗證依據
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence for Check TSV aspect ratio
knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍」。可藉由「由剖面資料計算孔深與最小孔寬比」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability. Evidence can be developed through this action: Calculate depth divided by minimum width from cross sections. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: TSV 深寬比核對的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Check TSV aspect ratio
knowledge.text: 入口寬度代替最窄處會低估填孔難度。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Using entrance width hides the narrowest fill restriction. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「TSV 深寬比核對」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Check TSV aspect ratio?
options: 以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：入口寬度代替最窄處會低估填孔難度。
optionsEn: Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Geometry falls within the approved tool capability
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Using entrance width hides the narrowest fill restriction.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍」。入口寬度代替最窄處會低估填孔難度，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability. Using entrance width hides the narrowest fill restriction, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare carrier thickness and flatness maps. optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Carrier wedge transfers into wafer thickness gradients.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Carrier errors do not exhaust thinning tolerance

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「光阻貼合完整且開孔區可圖形化」。可藉由「檢查微孔附近光阻架橋與空氣夾入」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Resist adheres and openings remain patternable. Evidence can be developed through this action: Inspect resist tenting and trapped air near microvias. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 乾膜光阻貼合的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Inspect dry-film resist lamination
knowledge.text: 光阻懸空可導致顯影形狀失真。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Unsupported resist can distort developed shapes. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「乾膜光阻貼合」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Inspect dry-film resist lamination?
options: 只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：光阻懸空可導致顯影形狀失真。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
光阻貼合完整且開孔區可圖形化
optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Unsupported resist can distort developed shapes.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Resist adheres and openings remain patternable
quiz.explanation: 應確認「光阻貼合完整且開孔區可圖形化」。光阻懸空可導致顯影形狀失真，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Resist adheres and openings remain patternable. Unsupported resist can distort developed shapes, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 有機芯或玻璃芯支線；玻璃通孔與有機鑽孔各用其合格路線，不可互換製程參數。
steps.routeEn: Organic-core or glass-core branch; glass vias and organic drilling use separately qualified routes.

steps.title: 雷射直寫套準
steps.objective: 判斷「雷射直寫套準」是否滿足此具體條件：局部殘差低於圖形套準容許量。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Verify laser direct-imaging registration meets this specific condition: Local residuals meet pattern-registration allowance.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：以分區標記修正面板尺寸變化。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Use regional fiducials to correct panel distortion. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：局部殘差低於圖形套準容許量；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Local residuals meet pattern-registration allowance. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 全板剛體修正可能不足以補償變形。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Rigid correction can miss panel distortion. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 局部殘差低於圖形套準容許量；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Local residuals meet pattern-registration allowance. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.title: 雷射直寫套準的驗證依據

options: 局部殘差低於圖形套準容許量

knowledge.text: 清洗過的晶粒可能被工具再污染。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Cleaned dies can be recontaminated by tools. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「晶粒工具潔淨度」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Inspect bonding-tool cleanliness?
options: 工具未引入可辨識接合區污染
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：清洗過的晶粒可能被工具再污染。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
optionsEn: Tools introduce no detectable bond-area contamination
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Cleaned dies can be recontaminated by tools.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「工具未引入可辨識接合區污染」。清洗過的晶粒可能被工具再污染，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Tools introduce no detectable bond-area contamination. Cleaned dies can be recontaminated by tools, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 晶圓對晶圓、直接晶粒對晶圓及集合轉移為替代支線；混合鍵合不能視為微凸塊回焊。
steps.routeEn: Wafer-to-wafer, direct die-to-wafer, and collective transfer are alternative branches; hybrid bonding is not microbump reflow.

steps.title: 對位標記辨識
steps.objective: 判斷「對位標記辨識」是否滿足此具體條件：中心估計穩定且可重複。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Validate alignment-mark recognition meets this specific condition: Center estimates remain stable and repeatable.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：在不同照明下比較標記中心估計。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare mark-center estimates under varied illumination. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：中心估計穩定且可重複；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Center estimates remain stable and repeatable. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 不對稱反光會偏移視覺中心。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Asymmetric reflections bias the optical center. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 中心估計穩定且可重複；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Center estimates remain stable and repeatable. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.title: 對位標記辨識的驗證依據
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence for Validate alignment-mark recognition
knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「中心估計穩定且可重複」。可藉由「在不同照明下比較標記中心估計」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Center estimates remain stable and repeatable. Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare mark-center estimates under varied illumination. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 對位標記辨識的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Validate alignment-mark recognition
knowledge.text: 不對稱反光會偏移視覺中心。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。

quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Validate alignment-mark recognition?
options: 以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。

optionsEn: Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Center estimates remain stable and repeatable
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Asymmetric reflections bias the optical center.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「中心估計穩定且可重複」。不對稱反光會偏移視覺中心，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。

steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Transform upper and lower camera data to one bond frame. route: 依產品採微凸塊熱壓、回焊或混合鍵合；本模組比較支線，不宣稱任何供應商固定堆疊配方。

knowledge.text: 載具順應性可能誤當焊點塌陷。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Fixture compliance can be mistaken for joint collapse. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「熱壓接合位移曲線」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Interpret thermocompression displacement curves?
options: 忽略此失效線索：載具順應性可能誤當焊點塌陷。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
位移變化與預期接觸事件一致
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
optionsEn: Ignore this failure clue: Fixture compliance can be mistaken for joint collapse.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Displacement changes match expected contact events
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「位移變化與預期接觸事件一致」。載具順應性可能誤當焊點塌陷，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Displacement changes match expected contact events. Fixture compliance can be mistaken for joint collapse, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.title: 局部熱歷程梯度
steps.objective: 判斷「局部熱歷程梯度」是否滿足此具體條件：全部接點經歷合格熱歷程。

steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare center and corner temperature histories. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.

steps.check: 全部接點經歷合格熱歷程；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「前緣到達遠端且未留未填區」。可藉由「讀取透明模型的時間序列」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Front reaches the far side without unfilled regions. Evidence can be developed through this action: Read time-series images from the transparent model. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 晶粒邊緣膠前緣的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Track the die-edge underfill front
knowledge.text: 可見邊緣濕潤不代表底部已充滿。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Visible edge wetting does not prove complete bottom filling. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「晶粒邊緣膠前緣」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Track the die-edge underfill front?
options: 只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：可見邊緣濕潤不代表底部已充滿。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
前緣到達遠端且未留未填區
optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Visible edge wetting does not prove complete bottom filling.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Front reaches the far side without unfilled regions
quiz.explanation: 應確認「前緣到達遠端且未留未填區」。可見邊緣濕潤不代表底部已充滿，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Front reaches the far side without unfilled regions. Visible edge wetting does not prove complete bottom filling, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.routeEn: Select capillary, molded, or preapplied underfill; lidded, lidless, and liquid-cooled interfaces are alternative structures.

steps.title: 充填膠圓角
steps.objective: 判斷「充填膠圓角」是否滿足此具體條件：圓角不侵入接點或光學保留區。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Measure underfill fillets meets this specific condition: Fillets avoid contact and optical keep-out regions.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：量測四邊膠圓角高度與延伸距離。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Measure fillet height and extension on all sides. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：圓角不侵入接點或光學保留區；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Fillets avoid contact and optical keep-out regions. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 過大圓角可增加局部剛性或污染。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Excessive fillets can increase stiffness or contaminate adjacent regions. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 圓角不侵入接點或光學保留區；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Fillets avoid contact and optical keep-out regions. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「每個指定焊墊恰有一顆球」。可藉由「觀察每個孔位的球數與偏心」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Each specified pad carries exactly one ball. Evidence can be developed through this action: Inspect ball count and eccentricity at each site. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 單球落位的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Inspect individual ball seating
knowledge.text: 雙球或偏球可能在回焊後橋接。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Double or off-center balls can bridge after reflow. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「單球落位」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Inspect individual ball seating?
options: 以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
每個指定焊墊恰有一顆球
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：雙球或偏球可能在回焊後橋接。
optionsEn: Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Each specified pad carries exactly one ball
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Double or off-center balls can bridge after reflow.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「每個指定焊墊恰有一顆球」。雙球或偏球可能在回焊後橋接，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Each specified pad carries exactly one ball. Double or off-center balls can bridge after reflow, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.title: 植球後漏球檢測
steps.objective: 判斷「植球後漏球檢測」是否滿足此具體條件：所有應植位置都有可辨識球體。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Detect missing balls after placement meets this specific condition: Every populated position contains a detectable ball.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：比對實際球圖與設計球圖。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare actual and designed ball maps. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：所有應植位置都有可辨識球體；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Every populated position contains a detectable ball. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 設計空位不可被誤判成漏球。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Intentional vacancies must not be labeled missing balls. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 所有應植位置都有可辨識球體；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Every populated position contains a detectable ball. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.text: 研磨拖抹可能看似材料橋接。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。

成分與幾何證據支持相同假說
optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Polishing smear can resemble a material bridge.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Composition and geometry support the same hypothesis

title: 終測、系統驗證與良率移交
titleEn: Final test, system validation, and yield handoff
description: 終測判斷當下功能，系統驗證判斷介面與任務行為；兩者均不等同完整壽命認證。本模組為 26 個可分支的判讀作業，課程順序不代表量產配方。網站提供原創示意模型；本模組未隨附逐步實測資料或商用允收門檻。
descriptionEn: Final test assesses present function and system validation assesses interfaces and mission behavior; neither alone establishes full lifetime qualification. These 26 branching interpretation exercises are a learning sequence, not a production recipe. The site supplies original schematic models, not per-step measured datasets or commercial acceptance limits.
route: 依邏輯、記憶體或 CPO 產品選測試支線；光學步驟只適用含光子元件的組件。
routeEn: Select logic, memory, or CPO testing branches; optical steps apply only to photonic assemblies.

knowledge.text: 直接功能上電可能掩蓋初始短路來源。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Immediate functional powering can obscure initial short origins. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「電源與地腳短路篩選」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Screen power-ground shorts?
options: 供電網路無非預期低阻路徑
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：直接功能上電可能掩蓋初始短路來源。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
optionsEn: Power nets have no unintended low-resistance paths
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Immediate functional powering can obscure initial short origins.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「供電網路無非預期低阻路徑」。直接功能上電可能掩蓋初始短路來源，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Power nets have no unintended low-resistance paths. Immediate functional powering can obscure initial short origins, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.title: 腳位導通覆蓋
steps.objective: 判斷「腳位導通覆蓋」是否滿足此具體條件：每種必要腳位有對應量測策略。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Verify pin-continuity coverage meets this specific condition: Every required pin class has a measurement strategy.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：將測試項目覆蓋到每個設計腳位。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Map test items to every designed pin. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：每種必要腳位有對應量測策略；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Every required pin class has a measurement strategy. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 共用電源腳需要避免虛假的覆蓋宣稱。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Shared power pins require avoiding false coverage claims. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 每種必要腳位有對應量測策略；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Every required pin class has a measurement strategy. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Every required pin class has a measurement strategy. Evidence can be developed through this action: Map test items to every designed pin. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「最差波長與偏振仍符合規範」。可藉由「在規定範圍比較光功率響應」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Worst-case wavelength and polarization meet criteria. Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare optical responses over the specified ranges. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: CPO 波長與偏振支線的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Evaluate wavelength and polarization response
knowledge.text: 單一波長功率合格不能代表全頻帶。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Single-wavelength passing does not establish full-band performance. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「CPO 波長與偏振支線」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Evaluate wavelength and polarization response?
options: 最差波長與偏振仍符合規範
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：單一波長功率合格不能代表全頻帶。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
optionsEn: Worst-case wavelength and polarization meet criteria
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Single-wavelength passing does not establish full-band performance.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「最差波長與偏振仍符合規範」。單一波長功率合格不能代表全頻帶，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
